Floette-Mega stats: HP 74, Atk 85, Def 87, SpA 155, SpD 148, Spe 102, ability Fairy Aura (1.33x Fairy moves for all on field). Light of Ruin 140 BP Fairy 90% acc.

G2 plan: TR mode (Farigiraf+Swampert-Mega+Gholdengo+Incineroar). No Taunt on opp team → Farigiraf guaranteed TR. Ice Punch 4x SE vs Altaria/Garchomp = likely OHKO. Gholdengo: resists Rotom-W TBolt (Steel 0.5x), immune WoW (Good as Gold). Incineroar: Intimidate+Fake Out+Parting Shot under TR (80 Spe = slow, good).

Future: If g3 needed, opp may expect TR now. Consider rain mode with Pelipper+Gholdengo switch-in for Rotom-W, or keep TR but adjust lead (Incineroar Fake Out + Farigiraf TR).

decisions.rationale: Altaria Cloud Nine neutralizes Drizzle, Rotom-W threatens 4x Thunderbolt OHKO on Pelipper to remove rain setter. Altaria sets Tailwind for speed control.
